axis_responsibility_gaps.gap: No single actor owns compute/storage budgeting across all model stores and runtimes. Docker recovery partially addressed host storage pressure, but long-term admission control is not centralized.
DAIOF-Framework is dormant. No active formal-logic runtime verified.
OpenAPI servers are independent; no unified registry or capability dispatcher verified.

summary: ANDY_SUPERSYSTEM has 20+ identified actors across 9 axes. Core green runtime is healthy. Several actors (Ollama, LM Studio, Pieces, Antigravity, VS Code family) duplicate model/IDE capability, creating storage debt but also fallback redundancy. Port 5000 is OS-reserved, not a HyperAI actor. Governance is distributed among OS Master, Agent OS, APO Gateway, and Devin. Responsibility gaps exist in Economics, Formal Logic, and unified OpenAPI coordination.
